Email Sticky Notes — Help & Support

Welcome to Email Sticky Notes. Keep your inbox organized with private, color-coded, timestamped sticky notes, interactive checklists, and reminders directly attached to your emails.

Gmail™ (Google Workspace Add-on) Guide

How do I open and use notes in Gmail?

1. Open any email message or conversation thread in Gmail (on Desktop or the official Gmail mobile app).
2. Click the Email Sticky Notes icon in Gmail's right-hand companion sidebar (or scroll to the bottom of the email on Android/iOS).
3. Click ➕ New Note or ⚡ Quick To-Do to add your first note.
4. Choose from 6 color themes, 4 priority tags, checklist items, and pin-to-top status.

How do I find all my notes across my mailbox?

Open the add-on homepage (or click the All Notes icon) to browse the Global Notes Hub. You can search and filter across all annotated emails by keyword, sender, subject, tag, or color.

Microsoft Outlook® Add-in Guide

How do I know which emails have a note?

Whenever you attach a note to an email in Outlook, the add-in automatically assigns an inbox category marker (📝 Sticky Note or 🔥 Urgent Note) so annotated emails stand out in your message list.

How do I keep the taskpane open while browsing emails?

Click the Pin (📌) icon in the top right corner of the Outlook taskpane. As you click through messages in your inbox, the notes will instantly update to match the active email.

Cross-Platform Portability & Backup

Can I transfer notes between Gmail and Outlook?

Yes! Both versions use compatible data structures. In either add-on, navigate to Settings (⚙️) and choose Export JSON. You can then import that file into the other platform to access your notes anywhere.

Where is my data stored?

Your privacy is our priority. In Gmail, notes are saved strictly in your private Google account via Apps Script UserProperties. In Outlook, notes reside in your Exchange item properties. Zero data is sent to external third-party servers.
